grader.scenario: Mobile SIM card randomly displaying No SIM error; resolution via eSIM conversion
grader.notes: Okay call featuring rude accusations and customer pushback resolved by digital eSIM activation, with handled empathy in the middle third and a repeated handset question in the final third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical faults' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Liam throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand how critical and urgent on-call veterinary emergencies are, Liam...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the SIM error problem in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for handset model at turn 42 despite customer stating iPhone 14 Pro at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent initially refused to send replacement SIM and told customer to drive to retail store.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'Well if you constantly drop your phone or carry it loose in pockets with metal keys, no SIM tray in the world is going to maintain contact spring tension.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding error behavior and device restart results.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: eSIM was successfully provisioned, test call to 17070 passed, and 5G connectivity was restored.
